Complete [[Tihark Orchard]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Talk to the three [[Princes of Vabbi|Vabbi Princes]] about joining your cause.
* *[[Bonus|BONUS]]* Participate in five festival activities.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 300 [[Sunspear rank|Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Tihark Orchard#Walkthrough|Tihark Orchard]] mission.
This is a solo mission and you must be the only person in your party.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"The royalty of [[Vabbi]] will be gathering in the [[Garden of Seborhin]], the most beautiful place in all of Vabbi, in a grand party to celebrate the Day of Lyss. Anyone wishing to see the princes, speak with them, or win their favor can observe the festivities from the [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], which overlooks the event."''
{{offer dialogue
